rows.name: Training Introduction
rows.sitrep: Rendevous with the fleet carrier Archon participating in wargame exercises in the Janus system.

rows.name: Carrier Qualifications
rows.description: Space-based fighters.  Practice launching, flying, docking, and basic spaceborne maneuvering.
rows.sitrep: The Third Fleet is participating in wargame exercises in the Janus system. The fleet carrier Archon has been detached to Janek orbit to practice spaceborne fighter operations.  As part of the exercise, you have been tasked with flying patrol patterns with your training instructor.

rows.name: Target Practice
rows.description: Space-based fighters.  Practice pairs combat against target drones.
rows.sitrep: The Third Fleet is participating in wargame exercises in the Janus system. The fleet carrier Archon has been detached to Janek orbit to practice spaceborne fighter operations.  As part of the exercise, you have been tasked with flying patrol patterns and destroying target drones in your sector.

rows.name: Flight School
rows.description: Airborne fighters.  Practice takeoffs, landings, and basic atmospheric maneuvering.
rows.sitrep: The Orion will jump to the Janek Airbase flight corridor. You will launch from the carrier, descend through the atmosphere and land at Janek Station. Begin the surface lesson after arrival. Your assignment is the 18th Trellis Wing aboard the CV6-Orion. The Third Fleet is participating in wargame exercises in the Janus system. Your squadron, the Avengers, are on temporary detached duty to Janek Station. As part of the exercise, you have been tasked with practicing take offs and landings, flying patrol patterns and destroying target drones in your sector.

rows.name: Ground Strike
rows.description: Air-to-ground action. Practice destroying ground targets.
rows.sitrep: The Third Fleet is participating in wargame exercises in the Janus system. Your squadron, the Stallions, are on temporary detached duty to Janek Station. As part of the exercise, you have been tasked with destroying support facilities for a simulated mining operation.
rows.objective: Training Strike - Destroy simulated mining operation.

rows.name: Training Cruise
rows.description: Learn to command starships. Practice engaging target drones with a Frigate class ship.
rows.sitrep: The Third Fleet is participating in wargame exercises in the Janus system. You will be in command of the Frigate Carlisle in Alystra sector.  After you destroy the target drones in that sector, rendevous with the Archon in Janek orbit to complete the exercise.

rows.name: Advanced Starship Combat
rows.description: Learn to command starships. Practice engaging starship targets with a Destroyer class ship.
rows.sitrep: The Third Fleet is participating in wargame exercises in the Janus system. You will be in command of the Destroyer Mahan in Dante sector. You have been tasked with finding and destroying the enemy Wolf-class starship Shannon. You have one hour to complete this exercise.  Good luck!
rows.objective: Training - Practice advanced starship combat maneuvers.

rows.name: Carrier Operations
rows.description: Learn to direct fleet operations. Practice orbital carrier operations.
rows.sitrep: The Third Fleet is participating in wargame exercises in the Janus system. The fleet carrier Archon has been detached to Alystra orbit to practice spaceborne fighter operations.
